Made the app significantly more secure.

What I changed:
- Added basic security headers and disabled `x-powered-by`
- Added request body size limits to reduce abuse
- Switched auth cookies to safer defaults
- Removed JWT exposure from API responses
- Tightened auth error handling for missing JWT secret
- Improved PostgreSQL connection hardening with timeouts and safer SSL behavior
- Increased password hashing cost and minimum password length
- Fixed task filtering to avoid incorrect query logic
- Updated tests and mock auth handling to match the security changes

Validation:
- Ran the full test suite successfully

If you want, I can also add:
- CSRF protection for cookie-based auth
- rate limiting for login/signup
- stronger password policy
- secure session rotation / token revocation
